profile.headline: Senior Web Application Developer
profile.summary:
I am a web application and database developer. I have experience with numerous industries, in particular investment banking. I have worked directly with my clients on all of my projects.

Specialties: I develop using ASP.NET with C#, JavaScript, AJAX, SQL Server, Oracle & Sybase.

As well, I'm familiar with php, MySQL, Coldfusion, MS Access, VBA, & VB

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: C# · AngularJS · Microsoft SQL Server · ASP.NET Core · TypeScript

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
I have developed several sites and web applications for different clients, with industries ranging from garbage collection to hedge funds.

Additionally, I have developed Access databases applications for different clients, ranging from a basic POS/inventory app for an eyeglass store, to a complicated event management database for the pharmaceutical industry.

positions.title: Senior Web Application Developer
positions.description:
Working on a team to build the next generation of social shopping carts.
Planning and designing integral sections of the application, which are interacting with multiple external API's.

positions.title: Web Application Developer
positions.description:
Working on two different distributed teams, one that handles conversion of data for the medical industry, and the other a web based patient health record website.
•	Developed components in C# to an existing system to convert medical data files to a generic type.
•	Responsible for getting specs, designing and implementing features to our web based MVC patient portal.
•	Handled data transformations utilizing SQL Server to maintain and set up user accounts on our web portal.
•	Developed rich user friendly UIs utilizing jQuery and Telerik Kendo components.

positions.title: Web Application Developer
positions.description:
Designed, developed and tested componants for multiple projects using C# and AngularJs.

Managed an outsourced team which developed componants for our system. I hanlded giving them specs, testing theor work, and providing feedback from the business for fixes and adjustments.

positions.title: Application Programmer
positions.description:
Working at a compamy that services the lending industry in the US by providing them with bankruptcy information.

I on the other hand am now an application programmer working with VS 2005 and C# along with SQL Server, and begining to work with mainframes.

positions.title: Web Application Developer
positions.description:
Worked on the Client Analytics Team, which serviced the Quantitative Trade & Derivative Strategy (QTDS) Team. This team primarily functioned to provide trading ideas to the equity traders. The web application which enabled them to disseminate their ideas was built using ASP.NET - C#, and utilized DHTML & JavaScript on the front end, with multiple backend databases (SQL Server, Sybase & Oracle) 

I was responsible for the entire lifecycle of the QTDS teams web application to provide trade ideas and options calculations to traders and external clients.
	•	Acted as the project manager, lead developer, designer, QA & support contact for this project
	•	Scoped out project with primary business contact, all the while managing expectations

I was also responsible for managing the merging of several web applications (written in ASP and ASP.NET) to provide the business with a single point of entry for a whole suite of tools.
	•	Designed multiple tiered web applications in C# and ASP.NET
	•	Designed and implemented a database model to handle user permissions across multiple applications using Oracle and SQL Server
	•	Designed and developed front end GUI of application utilizing HTML/Javascript/AJAX

And I had designed, developed and maintained the associated relational databases of SQL Server and Oracle.
